problemStatement.formal: Let f(N) = sup { |A| : A ⊆ {1,...,N}, ∀s ∈ A+A, s is squarefree }. Estimate f(N).
problemStatement.plain: Let f(N) be the size of the largest subset A ⊆ {1,...,N} such that every element of A+A is squarefree. Estimate f(N).
whyMatters: Connects number theory (squarefree numbers) with additive combinatorics

Related to density arguments and Chinese Remainder Theorem
